scientific_interpretation: In true tissue biopsy data from GSE62928, the 7 consensus hub genes exhibit modest directional concordance (2/7 concordant; LTB and ADAM19 positive; binomial P = 0.4531). The composite hub score yields an AUC of 0.4375 (Mann-Whitney P = 0.6571), performing identically to the random-gene-set null (empirical P = 0.6040). This divergence highlights a critical biological reality: dialysate effluent cellular fractions (GSE125498) reflect leukocyte-driven immune-matrisome crosstalk, whereas surgical biopsies (GSE62928) capture dense, end-stage collagenous fibrotic scar tissue with hypocellularity. Previous reports of AUC = 1.0 were driven by in-sample overfitting and artificial simulation.
